hints.title: Circular Difference Canonical Key
hints.text: All strings in the same shifting sequence have identical differences between adjacent characters modulo 26.

hints.title: Normalized Signature Formation
hints.text: Convert each string into a tuple of differences (ord(s[i+1]) - ord(s[i])) modulo 26 to uniquely identify its family.

hints.title: Equivalence Class Bucketing
hints.text: Map each string signature to a list of original strings. Iterate through the input list, group by signature, and return the aggregated values.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * L) time and O(N * L) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise testing of all string shifts requires quadratic O(N^2 * L) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing canonical modulo 26 delta tuples partitions all strings in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle modulo arithmetic properly, preventing negative difference wrapping issues.
